drivingQuestion: Why was the new year for trees set on the first of Shevat?
outcomeNote: The reason is supplied by R' Elazar in the name of R' Oshaya

segments.he: בְּאֶחָד בִּשְׁבָט רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה לָאִילָן. מַאי טַעְמָא? אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר אָמַר רַבִּי אוֹשַׁעְיָא: הוֹאִיל וְיָצְאוּ רוֹב גִּשְׁמֵי שָׁנָה, וַעֲדַיִין רוֹב תְּקוּפָה מִבַּחוּץ.
segments.en: § The mishna taught: «On the first of Shevat is the new year for trees,» according to the statement of Beit Shammai. The Gemara asks: «What is the reason» that the new year for trees was set on this date? «Rabbi Elazar said» that «Rabbi Oshaya said:» The reason is «since» by that time «most of the year’s rains have» already «fallen, and most of the season,» i.e., winter, «is yet to come,» as it continues until the spring equinox, which usually occurs in Nisan.
